user_constraint: 先分析，再判断下一步怎么改；先不要启动新训练。

evidence.scope: original full C80, frozen seed0 and teacher; no held-out selection

mse_dual.scope: C80-only finite counterfactual step probes; no deployment checkpoint saved, no held-out selection

dual_dual.scope: C80-only finite counterfactual step probes; no deployment checkpoint saved, no held-out selection

latent_latent.scope: C80-only finite counterfactual step probes; no deployment checkpoint saved, no held-out selection

action_action.scope: C80-only finite counterfactual step probes; no deployment checkpoint saved, no held-out selection

question: Can matched full-C80 refinement with actual-loss step selection close the optimization gap and improve both original held-out metrics?
start: Each arm retains its own original final80 parameters. Saved-state candidates retain that same source Adam state; fresh-state candidates reset m/v/step. Both candidate families are offered equally to all arms.
frozen: 614 clipping ratios and 1806863 channel log2 scales only
VQ books, indices, row gains, exponents and model weights
original heldout40 cases x seeds[0,1] and shared teacher

refinement.selection: Minimum full-C80 own-objective mean, using no held-out values. If no candidate improves, retain source and report no improvement.
refinement.budget_label: 80 additional gradient queries in one full batch; this is not 80 additional optimizer updates.

reuse.kl_gradients_and_C80_candidate_metrics: Reuse completed dual_dual gradient and six C80 candidate conditions if source/runtime replay passes; do not use mse_dual as the MSE-gradient control.
reuse.mse_control: Must compute MSE+NMSE gradient at MSE final80 and offer the same six candidate conditions. mse_dual used a dual-KL gradient and is not this control.

heldout.reference: Equally refined MSE control, plus original final80 as context.
heldout.joint_gate: Both motor RMSE and latent NMSE below matched refined MSE; motor median paired delta<0 and at least24/40 cases improve. Report both KL components separately.
heldout.claim_gate_for_both_KLs: Report action KL and latent KL against the equally refined MSE. Do not claim both information-loss terms improved if either is higher.

deferred: Do not enlarge calibration or change epsilon, lambda, KL construction or channel granularity in this refinement. If optimization improves but held-out does not, isolate standardization/energy weighting with a matched weighted-MSE control.
arm_choice_reason: Dual-KL saved-state quarter-step has negative C80 mean and median, 44/80 improved cases, and a strictly negative equal-suite leave-one-case-out mean range. Other units' best mean gains can change sign on one-case omission; prioritize dual-KL versus a matched MSE refinement to reduce GPU cost.
